title: Chris Bledsoe's inconclusive visit to Skinwalker Ranch was not aired

tellings.quote: He did. We didn't end up airing um that content. Um

plain: A man named Chris Bledsoe came to Skinwalker Ranch, a property in Utah known for reports of strange events, and the footage from his visit was never put on air. That comes from Brandon Fugal, the ranch's owner, who took part. He tells Michels the visit happened but says only, "We didn't end up airing um that content," which suggests nothing conclusive came of it.
